item.title: Digital employees: thoughts on the new AI-Native assembly line
item.description: - 文章探讨 AI Native 组织中的“数字员工”，认为它可能成为串联人员、AI 与知识的全新流水线，核心是对齐目标与上下文。 - 数字员工应定位为面向业务单元、随时在线的协同型“PM”，主动感知群聊、协作板和会议中的信息，澄清需求、协调人员、派发任务并持续跟进。 - 数字员工不同于执行具体任务的 Agent 或面向个人的数字分身：它通过协同层连接执行层，沉淀业务上下文与组织资产；执行层则负责运行 Agent 和工作流完成任务。 - 平台应易于创建、开箱即用且可定制，能与执行层顺畅衔接并运行在云端。短期效率红利主要来自执行层，长期提升组织效率的关键在于协同层。

item.title: Pinky: let any AI agent use your iPhone and Android — open source by @DIYgod
item.description: - Pinky 是一个免费开源项目，可让 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Cursor 等 AI Agent 通过 MCP 操作 iPhone 或 Android 手机；支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。 - 用户可在电脑上查看操作、随时接管，并审批付款等高风险操作；还可设置发送消息、删除内容等操作需先确认。审批规则由 Pinky 网关执行，Agent 无法自行批准。 - 银行、钱包和密码管理应用默认对 Agent 隐藏，Agent 也无法在密码或一次性验证码字段中输入内容。每次操作均会记录步骤、截图和屏幕录像，数据保存在本机。 - Pinky 采用原生轻量应用，基于 Apache-2.0 开源；目前处于预发布阶段，支持 Android 10–17 和 iOS 17.4 及以上版本。

item.title: Agents on Notion Can Now Share Knowledge and Skills (@NotionJP)
item.description: Notion Japan (@NotionJP) announced that agents on Notion can now share knowledge and skills. ChatGPT, Claude, Muse, and Bot can save what each has learned into the same memory and use shared skills. The original post is in Japanese and attaches a 36-second 1920×1080 demo video (the t.co link expands to the video, not a separate article). In other words, these Notion-hosted agents no longer keep private notebooks and private skill sets — what they learn is written to shared memory, and skills can be reused across agents.

item.title: Agent Memory Isn't About Storing More: Anthropic's Four Layers and Dreaming (@Smartpigai)
item.description: Smartpig (@Smartpigai) walks through Anthropic’s engineering post “The components of agent memory.” Many agent-memory projects only store chat logs, embed them, and retrieve with vector search — an approach he says overcomplicates things from the start. The core claim: memory is not about storing more, but about knowing what is worth remembering, when to recall it, and when to forget. The post splits memory into four layers: Transcripts (raw event logs), Memory Notes (experience notes that include a conclusion and why it is trustworthy), Memory Representations (a background wiki that can be navigated), and Injected Context (preload what matters; retrieve the rest; Claude Code Auto Memory loads only the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md). The technically interesting piece is Dreaming: idle compute reviews past tasks, distills reusable rules, corrects mistakes against raw transcripts, organizes a wiki, cleans contradictions, and decides what to inject next time. Results cited: CL-Bench database task, Opus 5.5 from 0.655 without memory to 0.838; in Pokémon, Sonnet 3.7 saved 413 files and earned 1 badge, while Fable 5 kept about 10 files and earned 4; on an enterprise corpus of ~350k docs / 420M tokens, search alone scored 53%, wiki+search 61%, saving ~20k tokens per question. His takeaway: the next generation of agent memory is less about RAG and more about memory lifecycle management. A reasonable engineering stack is Event Log + Structured Memory + Knowledge Wiki + Retrieval + Background Consolidation (Dreaming).

item.title: Grok Bot + Obsidian: An Automatic, Evolvable Second Brain (@Jackywine)
item.description: Jackywine (@Jackywine) recaps a month of handing his local Obsidian vault to a Grok Bot now named “Jackywine Digital Garden” (formerly “Obsidian Apprentice”; https://x.ai/bot/gdq_d-d9OCnnREs3VwGdV). A read-only diagnosis on Sept 17 found ~5,488 markdown files, nearly 40% empty stubs in the root, and ~8,000 unresolved links — the illness he named “collecting disguised as thinking.” He set four guardrails: file over app, AI output only into AI outputs/, atomic flomo imports, and sparse properties. In October he instituted a “content iron rule” (don’t write what you haven’t lived), stopped a stripped wikilink pack and an idle daily linking report, and wrote apprentice rules. On Nov 6 he renamed and split roles (flomo as memory, Obsidian as disk), walked onboarding one question at a time, wired up obsidian-cli, re-diagnosed (5,661 notes; unresolved links down to 4,747; stubs still ~43%), shipped an evergreen-note skill, and open-sourced jackywine-digital-garden-skills (7 skills, MIT). Thesis: a bot’s strength is that it can act; his most valuable decisions were what he forbade it to do. Judgment stays human. The article includes diagnosis, onboarding, apprentice, evergreen-note, related-notes, and orphan-notes prompts.

item.title: Swarm Rebuild: multiplayer cursors rebuild any page live
item.description: - Swarm Rebuild 是一款 Chrome 扩展，可将任意网页变成空白画布，再由一群多彩的协作光标实时逐步重建页面，包括绘制方框、输入文字、描边和摆放卡片等。 - 点击工具栏图标或按 Alt+Shift+S 即可启动；滚动页面时光标群会跟随并增加成员。可使用自动导览和 1×、2×、3×速度选项；完成后可返回原网页或重播重建过程，按 Esc 可随时退出。 - 扩展仅在用户主动点击的当前标签页中运行；不收集、存储或传输数据，没有网络请求、分析功能或远程代码，也不使用麦克风。 - 灵感来自 Joel Califa 的 Swarm 项目，代码已开源。商店页面显示约 4.7 分、32 条评价和约 9,000 名用户。

item.title: Agents are going async: DeepSeek Super-agent meets LangChain's "Agents Are Going Async" (@Xudong07452910)
item.description: - DeepSeek 提出 Super-agent，LangChain 发布《Agents Are Going Async》，两者共同体现了 Agent 架构从单个会话执行循环向可持续处理多项任务的工作系统演进。 - LangChain 的 Deep Agents 引入异步子 Agent：主 Agent 负责与用户交互，耗时任务交由拥有独立线程的后台子 Agent 执行，并在启动后立即返回。 - 后台任务运行期间仍可调整控制，例如发送新指令、中断后重新执行，或等当前工作完成后再处理；任务状态会单独保存，完成时还可主动通知主 Agent。 - LangChain 侧重任务执行中的异步调度与控制，DeepSeek 则探索借助 GitHub、飞书等事件主动发现和推进工作；Agent 的实用性也取决于用户能否放心委派并随时介入。

item.title: Nothing to Hide: iA on AI watermarks — putting writers back in control
item.description: - 欧洲新的 AI 透明度规则旨在保护消费者免受机器生成文本的操纵，但 AI 水印可能让读者变成监视者，助长恐惧与不信任。iA 认为，阅读和写作应当丰富、愉悦并解放人，而不是让人担心被指控。 - AI 水印依靠文本中隐藏的生成模式；检测器可能误判人类写作、漏掉 AI 文本，也可能因改写而失效。持续检查文本是否由 AI 生成，会损害读者与作者之间的信任，使写作变成躲避指控的游戏。 - AI 也能用于准备、讨论、拼写和事实检查，以及精简文字。关键在于透明地标记 AI 的贡献，并由作者重新审视、改写生成内容，让文字真正表达自己的意思；iA Writer 可标记并区分人类与 AI 撰写的部分。 - iA 主张将人类与机器生成的文字清楚区分，把创作控制权交还作者。使用 AI 时，应具体说明它如何、在哪里参与，并像引用其他文本一样对待 AI 生成内容；iA Writer 的作者标记功能旨在帮助看清各方的贡献，而非赞美或谴责 AI。

item.title: The Edge-Play Economy Isn't About Sexual Repression: Relationships Can't Grow, So the Market Sells Intimacy in Parts (Zhineng Luzhang, Bilibili)
item.description: A 28-minute Bilibili monologue by Zhineng Luzhang. Paid flirtation is booming in China: 'business rafting', pool-table hostesses, hiking escorts, romance role-play, 'sweet duo' gaming partners. What people lack is a relationship where someone looks back at them. Shared neighborhoods and idle time have faded, and modern freedom to not choose and to exit breeds uncertainty. item.title: agent-desktop: Vercel Labs open-sources desktop computer use via OS accessibility trees
item.description: agent-desktop is Vercel Labs' open-source (Apache-2.0) Rust CLI and C library that gives any agent—Claude Code, Codex, Cursor—desktop computer use through OS accessibility trees instead of screenshots. Snapshots return JSON with a ref per actionable element; agents act on refs and re-snapshot to verify, with STALE_REF on UI changes. Headless by default (no cursor or focus stealing), 56 operational commands on macOS/Windows/Linux, and self-reported 78–96% token savings via skeleton traversal. Web pages stay with agent-browser.
